design.habitat: H-M mildly-biased scatter (21 bands, pool quantile tuned)
design.arrangement: distance profile and 10 km block spread matched to the 0.2778 artifact; uniform draw inside the top-q habitat pool; strict 8-neighbour isolation

gate.note: Payload Dice is computed on the scoreable region only: pixels on the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue are excluded from evaluation per organizer statement, so two rasters can differ by tens of thousands of pixels and still be scoring-identical. 8GEMSDOE Hedge-v2 is exactly that case (pearson_raw 0.8700, 54,533 added pixels, 100.00% of them on the catalogue, dice_payload 1.0000, score 0.1563 identical to GEMSDOE).

metric_identity.formula: TI = T / (0.2*T + 0.2*F + 0.8*M), F = n - S, S = sum_x max_g k(d)
metric_identity.marginal_bar: keep a dot iff its credit t > 0.2*TI (0.0556 at TI=0.2778)
metric_identity.verified_against: official worked example TPw=3.00 FPw=1.89 FNw=2.00 -> 0.6027 vs stated 0.60
metric_identity.correction: the previously recorded marginal bar 0.0476 and the claim that the 0.2778 artifact over-emits ~4x are both wrong: its implied mean credit per dot is 0.105-0.121 across M in [8355,11153], above the 0.0556 bar
